prompt: A long-lens view from far down the slope, looking up the hill at the bunker from the first image: the overgrown concrete portal and its green steel doors sit small in the middle of a big bare chalk down under a heavy grey sky, a pale cream loudspeaker horn just visible on a bracket above the doors.
